scope: Local 0PN force conjugate to relative mean layer strain at fixed order. The Q=0.25 draining mouth supplied the initial frames. Bath, mobility, local geometry and softening of cross-layer bonds are prescribed. Force is on a finite patch.
comparison: Frozen step-response convolution versus an independently driven T/4 pulse. Primary validation used fresh bath noise on eight paths conditional on four archived parent labels. The 0.95 parents shared one entry geometry. The thermal resolution and ensemble spread refer only to these preparations.
controls: Opposite and half drives, zero control, two integration steps, raw force and clamp checks, static spring comparator, direct bath force, separate integrated recovery. Relaxed noiseless checks fix one parent per order and compare free and restrained patch orientation.

setsid --wait python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool strain-assay-review --memory-gib 2 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/strain_hold64_referee_02 -- python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import trapezoid
base=Path("_scratch/s11c/strain_hold_layered_ensemble")
paths=[base/"frozen64.npz",base/"pulse64.npz"]
pins=["0723119237060a882f6e06089a67a8d730e3038bc88f03b4201e69c56f20316c","ea4ec3b35e316041a586ef060916cf08dfe4b6fd77f97bd3a78cb3482526564d"]
assert [hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths]==pins
with np.load(paths[0]) as f, np.load(paths[1]) as p:
    orders,t,held,pred,obs=f["orders"],f["time"],f["held"],f["predicted"],p["actual"]
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(t,p["time"])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(f["parent_index"],np.repeat(np.arange(4),16))
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(f["parent_index"],p["parent_index"])
    assert len(set(f["seeds"])&set(p["seeds"]))==0
late=t>=.9*t[-1]
recovery=t>=.25*t[-1]
loading=t<=.25*t[-1]
rng=np.random.default_rng(86021)
counts=rng.multinomial(16,[1/16]*16,size=(2,4000,4)).reshape(2,4000,64)/64
for j,order in enumerate(orders):
    k=held[j].mean(axis=0)
    y=trapezoid(obs[j][:,recovery],t[recovery],axis=1)
    yh=trapezoid(pred[j][:,recovery],t[recovery],axis=1)
    x=trapezoid(obs[j][:,loading],t[loading],axis=1)
    conditional=lambda a: np.quantile(a,[.025,.975]).tolist()
    error=pred[j].mean(axis=0)[recovery]-obs[j].mean(axis=0)[recovery]
    tail_rms_ratio=np.linalg.norm(error)/np.linalg.norm(obs[j].mean(axis=0)[recovery])
    print(json.dumps(dict(order=float(order),initial=float(k[0]),late_retention=float(k[late].mean()/k[0]),loading=float(x.mean()),signed_recovery=float(y.mean()),predicted_signed_recovery=float(yh.mean()),observed_parent_impulses=y.reshape(4,16).mean(axis=1).tolist(),conditional_95_observed=conditional(counts[0]@y),conditional_95_predicted=conditional(counts[1]@yh),conditional_95_difference=conditional(counts[1]@yh-counts[0]@y),tail_rms_ratio=float(tail_rms_ratio),source_sha256=pins,bootstrap_draws=4000,bootstrap_seed=86021),allow_nan=False))'
